points.headline: Anthropic ships Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 as it heads for a record IPO.
points.body: Fable 5.2 went straight to first place on Artificial Analysis and both models are on Amazon Bedrock, while Mythos's bug-finding is going into Cisco and IBM security products. Anthropic is also reportedly seeking a $1.3 trillion IPO valuation.

points.headline: The Nvidia spy scandal turns into a legal and geopolitical problem.
points.body: Nvidia shares fell more than 4% after the board opened its probe into Jensen Huang's affair with a suspected Chinese asset, and securities suits are lining up. The case also weakens Nvidia's lobbying to loosen chip export rules for China.

points.headline: DeepMind's AlphaProof Code formally proves Signal's encryption is secure.
points.body: AI agents and human experts wrote three million lines of Lean proofs covering Signal's post-quantum handshake and Triple Ratchet. DeepMind's stated goal is machine-checked guarantees for software in general.

points.headline: Robots get their own foundation models at CoRL.
points.body: NVIDIA launched GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0, Google released Gemini 4 Argon for robot control and simulation, and Nature Will unveiled a 50-billion-parameter model for dexterous hands. At home, Ring is launching an AI indoor drone and a patrol rover.

points.headline: Data centers' power hunger becomes a climate and political fight.
points.body: Reporting from Virginia suggests the backlash is mostly about electricity bills, and at the UN climate talks critics say AI's climate case is unproven, just as Anthropic buys $3.4 billion of gas turbines. Scott Wiener, author of California's AI safety bills, now takes Nancy Pelosi's seat in Congress.

points.headline: AI tools become a new security weak spot.
points.body: Claude Code settings files committed to GitHub are leaking thousands of secrets, and a breach at inference provider Fireworks AI reached Notion's customers. Hugging Face warns that rising attacks could force open AI platforms to lock down.
